# Support

Use the channel that best matches what you need:

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/kdjzykMTHJ): ask a short build question, compare implementation approaches, or share progress with other builders.
- [OmniDimension community](https://community.omnidim.io): ask a longer integration question or publish a walkthrough in Show & Tell.
- [Developer documentation](https://docs.omnidim.io/docs): product, API, SDK, and dashboard references.
- [GitHub issues](https://github.com/Omnidim/examples/issues): reproducible bugs or a concrete improvement to an example.

Do not include API keys, call recordings, customer data, or internal URLs in a public post or issue.
